purpose: Live off-camera removal probe for the normal-enemy callback.
conclusions: With the camera held at (0,0), the live normal-enemy callback takes the off-camera removal path and clears object+0x18 on its first update.
Static 01F7:1DEE also clears the ARE record high byte at FS:[object+0x1A+1], so a later camera-region scan can recreate the object from that declaration.
The callback-clear observation is shared removal/deactivation evidence, not a player-caused death or drop path.
